model_description: Learned Horner ensemble with width-9 and width-16 TCN specialists for Tiers 2-3 plus separate 99,824-parameter width-independent cellular specialists through Tiers 4 and 5. Each scans a sanctioned pairwise-reduced operand through a trained recurrent state and emits one base-p digit. Inputs above the learned boundary receive a deterministic zero fallback.
training_description: The Tier-2/3 specialists were trained for 2,400 AdamW steps using learned width transfer and quotient-2/boundary mining. The cellular specialists used mixed-width curricula followed by direct width-32 or width-64 continuation; the width-64 endpoint additionally used autonomous-state recovery. Frozen five-seed gates scored 499/500 on Tier 3, 483/500 on Tier 4, and 480/500 on Tier 5. Checked Tier-3/4/5 answers were not used for training or selection. Seed 20260712.
